name: Hum
tooltip: Removes mains hum and its harmonics

name: Depth
tooltip: How deep the notches cut

name: Harmonics
tooltip: How many multiples are notched; buzz needs more than hum

name: Width
tooltip: Notch width; wider follows unstable mains

name: Frequency
tooltip: Mains fundamental; Find measures it, tracking follows drift

name: Click
tooltip: Repairs clicks and crackle

name: Threshold
tooltip: Higher catches more clicks, and also drum hits

name: Length
tooltip: The longest span repaired as one click

name: Crackle
tooltip: Adds repair of dense tiny clicks

name: Mode
tooltip: Clicks for isolated pops, Crackle for dense noise

name: Noise
tooltip: Reduces steady hiss and noise

name: Reduction
tooltip: How much of the noise floor is taken away

name: Smooth
tooltip: Slower gain avoids watery artefacts

name: Floor
tooltip: The noise level assumed; Learn or Adaptive set it

name: Profile
tooltip: Learned uses a captured profile, Adaptive follows the floor

name: Reverb
tooltip: Reduces the room tail behind the source

name: Amount
tooltip: How much of the room's tail is removed

name: Tail
tooltip: How long the room rings; Estimate measures it

name: Attacks
tooltip: Keeps attacks untouched so consonants stay sharp

name: Listen
tooltip: Removed plays only what was taken away

name: Trim
tooltip: Output level

name: Bypass
tooltip: Bypass the plugin (latency compensated)
